title: docs(design): MCP local-first door — design and measurement plan (draft for the decision card)
body:
Refs #34659 (a decision card; this PR does not close it).

## What changes

Adds `docs/design/mcp-local-first-door.md`: the design and the measurement plan for the open-source MCP draft door, the local export / simulate / submit loop, the 问数 skill, and the changes proposed for the cloud door. It is a draft for the maintainer's ruling: every decision in it is open.

## Why

The maintainer asked this session to take over the measurement and design work for the card. The research behind it found three readings the card did not have:

- A draft save runs no authoring rule (schema parse only), so a draft door must return the publish verdict itself.
- An MCP OAuth token is not accepted on the REST metadata routes.
- The Studio draft review depends on open packages only.

## Verification

Documentation only. Every file and line cited in the document was read on objectstack `62d9d0d99` and cloud `53a5844`. The Measurements table marks each row as measured, partial or pending; rows M1 and M4 are still running and will be filled in on this branch.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No code.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran; lint not run on a docs-only diff.)
- [ ] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. (The branch name is the session's assigned one, not `claude/issue-<n>-<slug>`.)
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset. (Publishes nothing.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to the generated or release-owned trees.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
